prerequisites: Proficiency in power laws and algebraic transformations
Knowledge of functions and their properties

learning_outcomes.text: Understand proof structures and perform informatics-relevant proofs
Reproduce the basics of algebra and logic and apply them to domain-specific tasks
Calculate with matrices, for example, to solve linear equation systems
Represent complex numbers in different forms to solve equations and inequalities
Reproduce, apply, and interpret formulas and theorems from differential calculus
Understand approximation methods and apply them to domain-specific tasks
Develop Taylor polynomials and estimate the error resulting from polynomial representation using Lagrange's remainder term
Verify functions as solutions to differential equations
Solve homogeneous differential equations with the exponential ansatz
